<tool_call>

<parameter=code>
def mblocks(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n'); m=[(i,j) for i in range(10,63) for j in range(64) if a[i][j]=='M']
    seen=set(); blocks=[]
    for (i,j) in m:
        if (i,j) in seen: continue
        stack=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
        while stack:
            x,y=stack.pop()
            if (x,y) in seen: continue
            seen.add((x,y)); comp.append((x,y))
            for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                if (x+dx,y+dy) in m and (x+dx,y+dy) not in seen: stack.append((x+dx,y+dy))
        blocks.append(comp)
    return blocks
def block_at(fr,r,c):
    for b in mblocks(fr):
        if (r,c) in b: return b
    return None
# mid-left square at [28-29,15-16]; click bottom-right (29,16)
b=block_at(current_frame,28,15)
print("mid-left before",sorted(b) if b else None)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':29,'col':16}])
b2=block_at(current_frame,28,15) or block_at(current_frame,29,15) or block_at(current_frame,30,15)
print("after click(29,16) bottom-right:",sorted(b2) if b2 else None)
# timer
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
whites=[j for j in range(64) if a[63][j]=='W']
print("timer",min(whites) if whites else None,"-",max(whites) if whites else None)

def mblocks(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n'); m=[(i,j) for i in range(10,63) for j in range(64) if a[i][j]=='M']
    seen=set(); blocks=[]
    for (i,j) in m:
        if (i,j) in seen: continue
        stack=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
        while stack:
            x,y=stack.pop()
            if (x,y) in seen: continue
            seen.add((x,y)); comp.append((x,y))
            for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                if (x+dx,y+dy) in m and (x+dx,y+dy) not in seen: stack.append((x+dx,y+dy))
        blocks.append(comp)
    return blocks
def block_at(fr,r,c):
    for b in mblocks(fr):
        if (r,c) in b: return b
    return None
